title: SNL Is Back! A Basketball Star Is Hosting the Big Season 52 Premiere
summary:
Get ready to stay up late — Saturday Night Live is back! The comedy show starts its 52nd season tonight, September 26, 2026.

This year's first host is Jalen Brunson. He's a point guard for the New York Knicks basketball team, and he just helped them win the NBA championship earlier this year. It's a little unusual for an athlete to host the season premiere, but since Brunson brought a big win to New York City, it makes sense.

The musical guest is KATSEYE, a global girl group with members from the Philippines, South Korea, Switzerland, and the United States. Two members, Manon and Sophia, are taking a break to focus on their mental health, so it's not clear if they'll perform.

There are some cast changes, too. Chloe Fineman and Bowen Yang have left the show. But fan favorites like Kenan Thompson, Colin Jost, and Michael Che are still there. Two new cast members, Saidah Belo-Osagie and Grace Reiter, are making their debut.

SNL airs live at 11:30 p.m. Eastern Time on NBC and Peacock. Next week, Dakota Johnson hosts with musical guest Turnstile.
why_it_matters: It shows how comedy, sports and music mix together on TV, and it is a reminder that even famous performers sometimes need to rest and look after their mental health.

background_read: Saturday Night Live (a live comedy show in the United States that has been on TV since 1975) starts a new season every autumn with a famous guest host and a music act.
The New York Knicks (a basketball team from New York City) play in the NBA, the top basketball league in the United States.
Sports stars have hosted SNL before — basketball legend Michael Jordan did it, and so did football star Peyton Manning.

KATSEYE is a global girl group whose members come from different countries, and in recent years many young pop stars have taken breaks from work to take care of their mental health, with fans cheering them on.
Article_Structure: WHO: Jalen Brunson, a New York Knicks point guard, hosts; KATSEYE is the musical guest; new cast members Saidah Belo-Osagie and Grace Reiter join the show.
WHAT: Saturday Night Live begins its 52nd season, with cast changes — Chloe Fineman and Bowen Yang have left, while Kenan Thompson, Colin Jost and Michael Che stay.
WHERE: Live from New York, on NBC and the streaming service Peacock, at 11:30 p.m. Eastern Time.
WHY: An athlete is an unusual choice to host the premiere, but Brunson just helped New York win the NBA championship, and next week Dakota Johnson hosts with the band Turnstile.

perspectives.description: They are excited to see the star who brought their city a championship try something completely different — making jokes on live TV.
Some are sad that cast members like Chloe Fineman and Bowen Yang have left, even though favourites like Kenan Thompson are still there.
They support Manon and Sophia taking a break for their mental health, but they are not sure whether the group will perform as a full team.
